ayahs.textEn: When the earth is shaken ˹in˺ its ultimate quaking,
and when the earth throws out ˹all˺ its contents,
and humanity cries, “What is wrong with it?”—
on that Day the earth will recount everything,
having been inspired by your Lord ˹to do so˺.

ayahs.textAr: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
ayahs.textEn: On that Day people will proceed in separate groups to be shown ˹the consequences of˺ their deeds.

ayahs.textAr: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.textEn: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it.

ayahs.textAr: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.textEn: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.
